newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: HI says sale of farms to Dole approved.
newsitem.headline: HI says sale of farms to Dole approved.

text.p: House of Investments (HI) said on Monday its board of directors had approved the sale of four of its banana firms to Dole Food Co Inc unit Dole Asia Ltd.
It told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Dole would make a part cash payment and sell back to HI part of its eight percent stake in HI.
The farms have a base price of $16.5 million.
HI is a conglomerate owned by Chinese-Filipino magnate Alfonso Yuchengco.
HI corporate secretary Marcelo Dy told the exchange in a statement that the actual number of HI shares to be acquired from the Dole Group has yet to be finalised.
